t: You're looking at Mossbourne Community Academy, a coeducational secondary school and sixth form in Lower Clapton, near Hackney Downs, in the London Borough of Hackney. It has academy status. The school was founded by Sir Clive Bourne, a British businessman who lived from 1942 to 2007. His name is the first half of the school's name, so every time someone says Mossbourne, they are echoing the man who set it up.
